description: A Next.js 16 App Router build with no AfterPack plugin, obfuscated afterwards by `afterpack .next/static/chunks`. Proves the CLI recognises the Next.js layout, renames every Turbopack chunk after its obfuscated bytes, rewrites the manifests, prerendered HTML and RSC payloads under .next/ that name them, and that `next start` still serves and hydrates the result.

build.note: build.mjs runs `next build`, then `afterpack .next/static/chunks` -- a plain `npm run build` already emits obfuscated, renamed chunks

interactions.description: The client island hydrates from the renamed chunks; the counter increments on click.

hydration.note: server-rendered HTML must agree with the client-hydrated DOM, so every rewritten chunk reference must resolve.
